description: This file contains shell functions and procedures for configuring and managing QMI network interfaces in a Linux-based embedded system, including initialization, setup, and teardown of network connections via QMI protocol.

methods.name: proto_qmi_init_config
methods.description: Initializes QMI protocol configuration parameters with default values and configuration options.

methods.name: proto_qmi_setup
methods.description: Sets up a QMI network interface, including device initialization, SIM card status checks, PIN verification, network registration, and IP configuration.

methods.name: proto_qmi_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the QMI network interface, stopping network connections and releasing resources.

methods.name: qmi_wds_stop
methods.description: Stops a specific WDS (Wireless Data Service) network session given its client ID and profile handle.
